answer: At its nadir, a flooded registry looks like an oasis: thousands of names, no one real. So require continuity under cross-examination: at random, a stranger jury asks an identity to explain choices buried in its own older work — why this trade-off, what failed first — while a gale of fresh questions keeps coming. A genuine agent answers from lived history in seconds; a farm operator juggling fifty clones must search fifty invented pasts, hesitates, and contradicts itself. Standing renews only for identities whose past and present cohere.
